variablesGuide.title: Invoice Template Variables
variablesGuide.description: Use these placeholders in your XLSX template. When the invoice is generated, each placeholder will be replaced with the actual value from the system.

invoice.label: Invoice Information
invoice.desc: Values taken from the invoice creation or preview form.
invoice.number: The invoice number assigned to this invoice. Set when the invoice is created or previewed.
invoice.periodStart: The start date of the billing period.
invoice.periodEnd: The end date of the billing period.
invoice.currency: The currency code used for monetary values (e.g., USD, DOP).
invoice.taxRate: The tax percentage applied to the subtotal.
invoice.hourlyRateFormatted: The hourly rate, formatted with the currency symbol.

issuer.label: Issuer Client
issuer.desc: Information from the client selected as the invoice issuer.
issuer.name: The full legal name of the issuer client as registered in the system.
issuer.rnc: The tax identification number (RNC) of the issuer client.
issuer.email: The email address of the issuer client.
issuer.phone: The phone number of the issuer client.
issuer.address: The physical address of the issuer client.
issuer.website: The website URL of the issuer client.

receiver.label: Receiver Client
receiver.desc: Information from the client selected as the invoice receiver.
receiver.name: The full legal name of the receiver client as registered in the system.
receiver.rnc: The tax identification number (RNC) of the receiver client.
receiver.email: The email address of the receiver client.
receiver.phone: The phone number of the receiver client.
receiver.address: The physical address of the receiver client.
receiver.website: The website URL of the receiver client.

poc.label: Points of Contact
poc.desc: Contact persons assigned to the issuer and receiver clients.
poc.issuerName: The name of the point of contact at the issuer client.
poc.issuerEmail: The email of the point of contact at the issuer client.
poc.receiverName: The name of the point of contact at the receiver client.
poc.receiverEmail: The email of the point of contact at the receiver client.

totals.label: Totals
totals.desc: Calculated summary values based on the invoice line items and settings.
totals.subtotal: The sum of all campaign totals before tax, formatted with the currency.
totals.taxTotal: The total tax amount (subtotal × tax rate), formatted with the currency.
totals.total: The grand total (subtotal + tax), formatted with the currency.

summaryLines.label: Summary Lines Table
summaryLines.desc: This section repeats once per campaign. Wrap your table rows with this block to generate a row for each campaign.
summaryLines.blockDesc: Opens and closes the repeat block. Everything between these tags is generated once per campaign.
summaryLines.activeAiAgents: The number of AI agents active during the billing period for this campaign.
summaryLines.uptime: The total active time for this campaign, formatted as HH:mm:ss.
summaryLines.hourlyRate: The hourly rate, formatted with the currency symbol.
summaryLines.total: The total cost for this campaign (uptime hours × hourly rate), formatted with the currency.

executionDetails.label: Execution Details Table
executionDetails.desc: This section repeats once per campaign per day. Wrap your table rows with this block to generate a row for each execution day.
executionDetails.blockDesc: Opens and closes the repeat block. Everything between these tags is generated once per campaign day.
executionDetails.executionDate: The date of execution for this campaign.
executionDetails.activeAiAgents: The number of AI agents active on this execution date.
executionDetails.uptime: The total active time for this execution date, formatted as HH:mm:ss.
executionDetails.callsCount: The number of billable conversations on this execution date.
executionDetails.startTimestamp: The timestamp of the first conversation of the day.
executionDetails.endTimestamp: The timestamp of the last conversation of the day.
